title: Publish Settings 'JPEG quality' slider is ignored — never reaches compileDocument
description:
FIXED (task 1287). The Publish-Settings JPEG quality slider now controls the published SWF's photo-bitmap encoding.

ROOT CAUSE: photo (JPEG) library bitmaps were embedded by passing their ORIGINAL dataUri JPEG bytes through verbatim (ensureJpegEOI(dataUriToBytes(dataUri))) in all four emit paths (compiler/characters.ts x2, sprite.ts, buttons.ts). CompileOptions had no jpegQuality field and Shell.tsx's usePublish call never forwarded publishSettings.jpegQuality. So changing the slider produced byte-identical photo tags.

FIX (quality threaded end-to-end):
- packages/swf/src/jpeg-encode.ts (NEW): dependency-free deterministic baseline JFIF JPEG encoder (encodeJpeg(w,h,argb,quality)). Same-pixels+quality -> same bytes (reproducible SWF). Lower quality -> smaller output.
- packages/swf/src/bitmaps.ts: resolvePhotoJpegBytes(bitmapItem, jpegQuality, pixelData) — re-encodes a photo's decoded ARGB pixels (already in CompileOptions.bitmapPixels, decoded by usePublish/buildBitmapPixels which already includes 'photo') at the chosen quality; falls back to original bytes when no quality / no pixels (legacy, unit tests, golden-parity). New types DecodedBitmapPixels / PhotoBitmapOptions.
- packages/swf/src/compiler/options.ts: added jpegQuality?: number to CompileOptions.
- compiler/characters.ts (scene main-timeline, 2 paths): use resolvePhotoJpegBytes. Transparency alpha block still preserved via DefineBitsJPEG3.
- sprite.ts + buttons.ts: added trailing photoOptions param; symbol-internal photo bitmaps re-encode too. Threaded via compiler/symbols.ts runSymbolPass <- compile.ts orchestrator.
- packages/authoring-ui/src/Shell.tsx: usePublish(doc, { ..., jpegQuality: publishSettings.jpegQuality }).
- index.ts: export encodeJpeg / resolvePhotoJpegBytes / types.

VERIFICATION (run in worktree):
- pnpm --filter './packages/**' build: GREEN.
- packages/swf vitest: 1451 tests, 0 failed (incl NEW src/__tests__/jpeg-quality.test.ts, 5 tests). Acceptance oracle 'two quality settings produce DIFFERENT, size-ordered DefineBitsJPEG2 payloads': PASS — decode our OWN compiled SWF's tag-21 image bytes at q20 vs q90 -> different bytes AND len(q20) < len(q90). Also: well-formed JFIF SOI/EOI, deterministic, re-encodes-from-pixels-not-dataUri, no-quality path unchanged (no regression).
- packages/core vitest: 5323 passed; 2 tests + 1 suite FAIL = pre-existing task-1207 missing-fixture (fixtures/flash8-empty.fla absent, not git-tracked) — unrelated, acceptable.
- packages/authoring-ui vitest: 765 passed.
- self-determinism.test.ts (golden determinism proxy) passed; jpegQuality undefined -> byte-identical output, golden-parity unaffected. (swf-dump binary not built in this worktree so golden-parity.mjs harness can't run; covered by unit determinism.)
